assets.name: 余烬·摩羯
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original CAPRICORN zodiac fantasy bow concept for a Skyrim solid-light weapon collection. One complete single upright bow in near-side view with subtle depth, limbs curve to LEFT and one thin straight taut bowstring on RIGHT attached at both tips; entire silhouette comfortably inside portrait 2:3 frame on pure black background. Build exclusively from substantial broad luminous geometric surfaces, bevelled faceted ribbons and thick structural arcs. Saturated visible colored body planes, sharp brighter colored edges, restrained halo, no white burnout. Compact functional continuous one-hand grip physically joins both limbs. Graceful coherent shapes and large purposeful negative spaces, not flimsy wires or clumsy attached ornaments. Capricorn abstracted from the backward sweep of mountain-goat horns, rugged mountain ridges and an elegant sea-tail taper. Never a literal goat head, animal sculpture, face, eyes, horns sticking from a creature, fish scales or fur. Avoid ram spiral circles, chains of polygon rings, hexagrams, floating disconnected grip, conventional wood/leather/metal, engraved details, characters, arrows, text, watermark. Two or three major geometric forms per limb, readily translatable into a game mesh. Sparse small local luminous particles near shoulders/limbs indicate proposed VFX, never obscure bow. Upper/lower balanced. Palette: deep ruby/crimson with rose-red emissive rims, no gold or orange. Design: SCARLET RIDGEBACK. A short solid flattened hourglass grip, compact angular saddle-shaped collars. Each shoulder sweeps backward into one thick open hooked arch like a goat horn cut from a geometric crescent, forming a LONG pointed triangular opening beside the palm, not a round ring. Each limb is a broad powerful ridge blade with two large broken-plane facets tracing a deep recurve; a slimmer inner blade nests alongside it leaving a slender tapering black gap. A single backward-pointing short facet at the outer elbow evokes a ridge spur. Small sharp faceted terminal tips, strong broad shoulders becoming elegant narrow ends. Red crystalline triangular chips and tiny rose sparks drift beside ridge corners. Silhouette should feel regal, tough, angular yet flowing, no feather fans.
